question: Using Ampere’s circuital law, obtain the expression for the magnetic field inside a long solenoid having $n$ turns per unit length and carrying current $I$. Hence calculate the field inside a solenoid of length $0.80\text{ m}$ having $1600$ turns and carrying current $2.0\text{ A}$. Take $\mu_0=4\pi\times10^{-7}\text{ T m A}^{-1}$.

options.A: Using an Amperian path, $Bl=\mu_0nI$, hence $B=\mu_0NI$. Here, $B=1.6\pi\times10^{-6}\,\text{T}$.
options.D: For a long solenoid, take an Amperian path partly inside: $Bl=\mu_0(nl)I$, giving $B=\mu_0nI$. Here, $n=\dfrac{1600}{0.80}=2000\,\text{m}^{-1}$, so $B=(4\pi\times10^{-7})(2000)(2.0)=1.6\pi\times10^{-3}\,\text{T}$.
